name: Hatoful Kareshi: HolidayStar
source:
Hatoful Boyfriend Holiday Star is the sequel to Hatoful Boyfriend and a separate game. There are 4 main episodes and 6 short episodes contained within it, a gallery, as well as a six part radio program that answers questions from the fans.

[From [url=http://hatoful.wikia.com/wiki/Holiday_Star]Hatoful.Wkia[/url]]
translation:
《电波系男友 Holiday Star》是《电波系男友》的续作，也是一款独立的游戏。其中包含4个主要章节和6个短篇章节，一个画廊，以及一个六集广播节目，回答粉丝们的问题。

[来自[url=http://hatoful.wikia.com/wiki/Holiday_Star]Hatoful.Wkia[/url]]
